hero.filename: Martin B-57B bombers at Phan Rang AB South Vietnam 1968.jpg
hero.caption:
Martin B-57B bombers at Phan Rang AB South Vietnam 1968
8th Bombardment Squadron Martin B-57B-MA 53-3898 converted to B-57G in 1969.  Returned to the United States and retired to MASDC as BM0092 Feb 7, 1974.

13th Bomb Squadron Martin B-57B-MA 52-1567 converted to RB-57B.  Loaned to South Vietnam AF but Remained under US control, 1965.  Program cancelled and returned to USAF Apr 20,1967.  W/o when hit by ground fire but was able to fly back to Phan Rang Mar 15, 1969.  Suffered dual flameout near Pleiku, South Vietnam.  Both crew ejected and were rescued by USAF HH-43 helicopter.

images.filename: U.S. Air Force De Havilland Canada C-7B Caribous and Douglas C-47Ds in Vietnam, circa in 1967.jpg
images.caption:
Two U.S. Air Force De Havilland Canada C-7B Caribou (s/n 63-9741, 63-9746) from the 457th Troop Carrier Squadron and three Douglas C-47D of the 9th Air Commando Squadron in Vietnam, circa in 1967. The location is maybe Phan Rang Air Base. The Caribous still wear the U.S. Army camouflage. They were transferred to the U.S. Air Force in January 1967.
The C-7B 63-9746 was later shot down by ground fire near Dak Seang, Vietnam, on 6 April 1970. The crew of three was killed.
